step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Payment returned — amount unreadable.”

Details: Type “A payment replacement request was submitted to IPOC for payment [reference number] issued on [DD-MM-YYYY] for the weeks of [DD-MM-YYYY] to [DD-MM-YYYY]. The payment was returned because the amount was unreadable.

step.cmd: Complete the INS5207 form as follows:

ul.li: SIN: Enter the SIN.
HRCC: Enter the Service Canada Centre as shown in FTS.
Requester: Enter the 7-digit user code.
Week Code(s): Enter the w/c of the payment to be replaced.
Warrant No(s): Enter the payment reference number that appears on the Payment Summary (MN19) information screen.
Amount(s): Enter the payment amount that appears on the Payment Summary (MN19) information screen.
Name: Enter the client’s surname and given name.

Address: Enter the client’s address as follows:
On the first line, enter the street address.
On the second line, enter the city, province and postal code.
Telephone number: Enter the client’s telephone number

Action: Type the appropriate information:
“The client has not received the payment issued more than 8 business days ago.”
“The client has not received the payment because it was sent to the wrong address. The address has been updated.”

step.cmd: In NWS, create an IPOC REV WI as follows:

ul.li: Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Language: Select the appropriate language.

Destination — SCC: Select the Service Canada Centre (SCC) of your regional IPOC:
Atlantic: Select 1826 .
Ontario: Select 3056 .
Quebec: Select 2642 .
Western Canada and Territories: Select 5903 .
End User: Select Next available user .
Issue: Select Payment replacement .
BPC: Enter the BPC of the claim.
Comments: Type “Payment replacement.”
Details: Copy and paste the information from the INS5207 form.
Obtained by: Select the appropriate option.
Obtained from: Select the appropriate option.
Source details: Enter the source details.
Select Save .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the F-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Text - Free Text (1612) : Type “On [insert date], a payment replacement request was submitted for payment [reference number] issued on [DD-MM-YYYY] for the weeks of [DD-MM-YYYY] to [DD-MM-YYYY]. Please be advised that the replacement time is 5 business days for direct deposit and 7 to 13 business days for regular mail.”

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI for the returned payment issue.
